papers.title: Cultural Evolution
papers.titleZh: 文化演化：文化差异和多样性的共同起源
papers.authors: Oded Galor; Marc Klemp; Daniel C. Wainstock
papers.takeaway: 研究把祖先环境差异、人口迁移和适应能力连接起来，解释社会之间的文化距离以及社会内部的文化多样性。
papers.abstractZh: 研究把祖先环境差异、人口迁移和适应能力连接起来，解释社会之间的文化距离以及社会内部的文化多样性。
papers.theory: 迁移和经济社会变化使继承的文化与新环境产生错配；代际调整、群体间扩散和选择共同推动文化演化。理论预测：祖先生态环境越不同，后代社会的文化距离越大；祖先多样性影响适应能力；共同环境带来的趋同并不必然消除多样性。
papers.data: 摘要列明民间故事、音乐传统、常见概念的视觉表示及规范价值观态度分布等多种文化测量。样本国家、族群数量、具体调查年份和匹配过程尚未核验。2026年8月首次发布，超出优先30天范围。
papers.method: 统一理论结合多类文化指标的实证检验；具体估计式、控制变量和识别策略尚未核验。
papers.results: 公开摘要报告多类实证证据支持理论预测；未核验系数和不确定性。
papers.relevance: 适合将文化传播的跨群体扩散与群体内部多样性放入同一分析框架。
papers.limitations: NBER工作论文，并非正式期刊；直接页面返回403，依据可检索官方摘要。不能将历史相关关系直接解释为因果。

papers.theory: 框架连接地理、工业化前社会特征、政治制度和历史冲击与规范形成，再区分父母到子女、同辈以及其他年长者的传递渠道。文化与制度相互作用，规范的稳定性需要按具体价值类型讨论。

papers.title: Beyond Translation: Cross-Cultural Meme Transcreation with Vision-Language Models
papers.titleZh: 超越翻译：视觉语言模型的跨文化梗图改创
papers.authors: Yuming Zhao; Peiyi Zhang; Oana Ignat
papers.takeaway: 研究以中美梗图双向改创区分字面翻译、意图保留和文化适配，并比较人类与模型评价；方向性结论在摘要和正文之间存在冲突。
papers.abstractZh: 研究以中美梗图双向改创区分字面翻译、意图保留和文化适配，并比较人类与模型评价；方向性结论在摘要和正文之间存在冲突。
papers.theory: 改创的目标是保留幽默机制和交流意图，同时替换只在来源文化中有意义的人物、典故、图像与表达风格。流程分开识别通用元素和文化特有元素，再分别生成目标文化文案和视觉模板，最后合成。文化适配因此是多模态的意义协调，不等于翻译文本。
papers.data: 6,315个原始梗图及对应改创图：中文到美国3,165对，美国到中文3,150对。中文来源是小红书、微博数据集，美国来源是MemeCap的Reddit素材。人工去除低质量、冒犯性、混合语言和图文关联弱的内容。中文与美国保留率分别97.6%和55.0%，样本筛选不对称可能影响比较。人工评价子集628对，分方向313和315对；另有628图用于情绪标注。
papers.method: LLaVA 1.6 13B分析文化及生成文案，FLUX.1 Schnell生成图像，Pillow合成；生成主流程无任务微调。每个测试梗图由3位双语双文化评价者评分，分别衡量文案、图像、图文协同、文化适配、意图保留，使用1至5分量表；模型评价另与人工评分比较。
papers.results: 摘要声称美国到中文优于反向；正文表2的三位人工评价者综合分却均为中文到美国更高（4.55对4.28、4.21对3.96、3.45对3.17），正文6.2又声称美国到中文更高。方向性结论因此不能直接采用。人工评价相关性报告0.58至0.81，但不能消除表文矛盾。
papers.relevance: 为跨文化传播提供可操作测量：是否保留意图、是否适合目标语境、图文是否协调，应分别测量。
papers.limitations: 预印本；只覆盖两种语境，少数双文化评价者无法代表整体受众。方向性冲突需要作者澄清，不能据此判断某文化传播天然更容易。
papers.originalAbstract: Memes are a pervasive form of online communication, yet their cultural specificity poses significant challenges for cross-cultural adaptation. We study cross-cultural meme transcreation, a multimodal generation task that aims to preserve communicative intent and humor while adapting culture-specific references. We propose a hybrid transcreation framework based on vision-language models and introduce a large-scale bidirectional dataset of Chinese and US memes. Using both human judgments and automated evaluation, we analyze 6,315 meme pairs and assess transcreation quality across cultural directions. Our results show that current vision-language models can perform cross-cultural meme transcreation to a limited extent, but exhibit clear directional asymmetries: US-Chinese transcreation consistently achieves higher quality than Chinese-US. We further identify which aspects of humor and visual-textual design transfer across cultures and which remain challenging, and propose an evaluation framework for assessing cross-cultural multimodal generation. Our code and dataset are publicly available at https://github.com/AIM-SCU/MemeXGen.

papers.title: Minding the Politeness Gap in Cross-cultural Communication
papers.titleZh: 留意跨文化交流中的礼貌差异
papers.authors: Yuka Machino; Matthias Hofer; Max Siegel; Joshua B. Tenenbaum; Robert D. Hawkins
papers.takeaway: 三项实验结合计算模型研究英美英语使用者如何理解quite和very，提示误解同时来自字面意义和表达成本。
papers.abstractZh: 三项实验结合计算模型研究英美英语使用者如何理解quite和very，提示误解同时来自字面意义和表达成本。
papers.theory: 递归语用模型把说话者视为在信息量、礼貌和表达成本之间权衡，把听者视为反推这种选择的人。研究区分词语语义差异与交流策略差异，避免把所有跨文化误解归结为民族礼貌规范。
papers.data: 摘要确认三个实验、英国与美国英语使用者以及程度副词解释任务。每项实验人数、招募渠道、年龄、刺激集合、排除规则和问卷量表未核验。2025年6月18日提交。
papers.method: 通过实验和计算认知模型比较，考察不同语义与成本权重的解释力。具体模型拟合、先验、参数和模型选择数值尚未核验。
papers.results: 摘要认为字面意义与表达成本权重的共同差异较能解释结果；不能据此推出礼貌完全没有作用。
papers.relevance: 设计跨文化内容时，应同时检查词汇意义和受众对表达方式的推断。
papers.limitations: 只有摘要核验；覆盖两个英语语境，不能泛化到所有文化或媒体效果。
papers.originalAbstract: Misunderstandings in cross-cultural communication often arise from subtle differences in interpretation, but it is unclear whether these differences arise from the literal meanings assigned to words or from more general pragmatic factors such as norms around politeness and brevity. In this paper, we report three experiments examining how speakers of British and American English interpret intensifiers like "quite" and "very." To better understand these cross-cultural differences, we developed a computational cognitive model where listeners recursively reason about speakers who balance informativity, politeness, and utterance cost. Our model comparisons suggested that cross-cultural differences in intensifier interpretation stem from a combination of (1) different literal meanings, (2) different weights on utterance cost. These findings challenge accounts based purely on semantic variation or politeness norms, demonstrating that cross-cultural differences in interpretation emerge from an intricate interplay between the two.

papers.title: Cross-Cultural Transfer of Commonsense Reasoning in LLMs: Evidence from the Arab World
papers.titleZh: 大模型常识推理的跨文化迁移：阿拉伯世界证据
papers.authors: Saeed Almheiri; Rania Hossam; Mena Attia; Chenxi Wang; Preslav Nakov; Timothy Baldwin; Fajri Koto
papers.takeaway: 使用13个阿拉伯国家的文化常识数据研究模型对齐能否跨国迁移，并与其他文化的示例比较。
papers.abstractZh: 使用13个阿拉伯国家的文化常识数据研究模型对齐能否跨国迁移，并与其他文化的示例比较。
papers.theory: 共同语言和历史背景可能支持知识迁移，但本地文化仍有差异。研究把一个国家的少量示例当作对齐信息，测试能否改进另一国家的常识推理；这里测量的是模型任务表现，不是人类价值观改变。
papers.data: 摘要明确数据覆盖13国，每个来源国家少至12个文化示例，并包含印度尼西亚和美国语境的比较。题目总数、国家分布、文化标注方法、模型名单及划分方式未核验。2025年9月23日预印本提交，记录注明EMNLP Findings。
papers.method: 比较上下文学习、基于示范的强化DITTO、监督微调和直接偏好优化；包含选择题推理以及文化内外示例对照。
papers.results: 摘要报告多语言模型平均改善约10%，但未说明是相对增长还是百分点，本站不擅自改写。文化外示例在部分选择题任务可匹敌或超过文化内对齐。
papers.relevance: 为数字文化中介提供假设：地区共同背景与一般示例能力可能分别产生迁移，应做独立比较。
papers.limitations: 摘要核验；缺少逐国结果及置信区间。模型正确作答不等于理解文化实践，不能替代受众研究。
papers.originalAbstract: Large language models (LLMs) often reflect Western-centric biases, limiting their effectiveness in diverse cultural contexts. Although some work has explored cultural alignment, the potential for cross-cultural transfer, using alignment in one culture to improve performance in others, remains underexplored. This paper investigates cross-cultural transfer of commonsense reasoning in the Arab world, where linguistic and historical similarities coexist with local cultural differences. Using a culturally grounded commonsense reasoning dataset covering 13 Arab countries, we evaluate lightweight alignment methods such as in-context learning and demonstration-based reinforcement (DITTO), alongside baselines like supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Our results show that merely 12 culture-specific examples from one country can improve performance in others by 10% on average, within multilingual models. In addition, we demonstrate that out-of-culture demonstrations from Indonesia and US contexts can match or surpass in-culture alignment for MCQ reasoning, highlighting cultural commonsense transferability beyond the Arab world. These findings demonstrate that efficient cross-cultural alignment is possible and offer a promising approach to adapt LLMs to low-resource cultural settings.

papers.title: Streaming diplomacy and the evolution of Hindi cinema: from Bollywood to digital narratives
papers.titleZh: 流媒体外交与印地语电影的数字叙事转型
papers.takeaway: 论文通过两部印地语流媒体作品的文本分析，讨论平台如何放大文化可见性，同时塑造叙事、性别和数字生活的表达。
papers.abstractZh: 论文通过两部印地语流媒体作品的文本分析，讨论平台如何放大文化可见性，同时塑造叙事、性别和数字生活的表达。
papers.theory: 流媒体外交指文化影响经日常叙事、情感和平台基础设施产生，不限于国家主导的宣传。作者连接平台资本主义、算法治理和软实力；形式分析依据Bordwell叙事理论，性别分析使用Mulvey和Gill，技术主体分析使用Haraway和Turkle。机制是平台的全球可见性与市场压力推动本地故事采用国际可理解的形式。
papers.data: 目的抽样选择Call Me Bae与Ctrl，两者均为2024作品。资料主要为公开视听文本，辅以学术文献和行业报告。没有观众调查，也没有曝光到态度变化的追踪数据。文本关注人物、场面调度、摄影、剪辑、界面叠加和符号。
papers.method: 定性解释设计：形式分析结合主题及批判话语分析，比较传统电影、电视和平台叙事结构。作者讨论具体场景时间点，但不是随机样本或因果识别。
papers.results: 作者认为两部作品把个体、性别与数字焦虑纳入本土叙事，使印度形象有新的国际表达，同时依赖平台规范。结论是文化空间的双重性，不是已经测得软实力提高。
papers.relevance: 适合把平台治理与文化内容的形式变化一起研究。后续可用跨国受众访谈或实验检验文本解释是否与受众理解一致。
papers.limitations: 两个目的选择案例，无法推断全部印度电影。平台治理的作用主要通过解释提出，实际算法和跨国观看效果没有独立测量。
papers.originalAbstract: Hindi cinema and Hindi-language television have historically occupied a significant position within Indian media culture, shaping national imaginaries and circulating India’s cultural soft power through theatrical exhibition and broadcast television. Though it has been one of the most popular forms of Indian screen culture; Indian cinema in its entirety, has maintained a sustained global presence—from the international recognition of Bengali cinema through filmmakers such as Satyajit Ray, particularly with Pather Panchali (1955), to the contemporary global circulation of regionally rooted blockbusters such as RRR (Rajamouli, 2022) and Kantara (Shetty, 2022), signalling the continuing international prominence of Indian screen cultures across linguistic and industrial contexts. This paper examines how contemporary Hindi web series and OTT cinema reconfigure India’s long-standing soft power legacy by extending it into the domain of streaming diplomacy. While recent pan-Indian and transnational films—such as Baahubali (Rajamouli, 2015), RRR, and All We Imagine as Light (Kapadia, 2024) continue to play a significant role in reshaping India’s global cultural presence through theatrical circulation and international festival circuits, this study deliberately narrows its focus to Hindi screen culture. It argues that this transformation is marked by the adoption of technical, aesthetic, and narrative strategies aligned with western, platform-driven production cultures, while simultaneously revising earlier Hindi screen traditions grounded in popular aesthetics and cultural specificity. Rather than emerging solely from creative innovation, these shifts are shaped by the structural pressures of platform capitalism, algorithmic governance, and market-oriented regimes of global visibility that increasingly mediate how India is projected on international platforms. Through textual analysis of Call Me Bae (D’Cunha, 2024) and Ctrl (Motwane, 2024), the paper explores how selective Hindi-language OTT texts focus individuality, postfeminist subjectivities, and anxieties surrounding social media, artificial intelligence, and digitally mediated intimacy. These narratives mark a departure from the collectivist ethos, melodramatic modes, and culturally embedded formats historically associated with Hindi cinema and television, even as they retain recognisably ‘desi’ narrative frames to ensure local resonance. Hindi screen culture has long been approached through a critical lens, often characterised as ahistorical, escapist, excessively melodramatic, and shaped by fragmented modes of production. However, the emergence of streaming platforms has significantly reoriented this landscape. OTT ecosystems have enabled greater narrative risk, more coherent production logics, and the sustained exploration of niche themes that were previously marginal within mainstream Hindi cinema and television. Freed from the constraints of box-office imperatives and broadcast scheduling, Hindi web series and OTT films increasingly engage with globally resonant concerns—such as gender politics, digital labour, surveillance, and urban precarity—while remaining embedded in local cultural idioms. In this sense, streaming does not simply correct earlier limitations of Hindi screen culture; it reorganises its aesthetic and ideological priorities, allowing melodrama and spectacle to be reworked into longer, more reflexive, and internationally legible forms of storytelling. Situating these developments within the framework of streaming diplomacy, the paper argues that Hindi-language OTT content continues to generate media-driven soft power by enabling culturally specific stories to circulate globally through platform infrastructures. The international recognition of Delhi Crime (Mehta, 2019), which won the International Emmy Award in 2020, demonstrates how Hindi-centric narratives can achieve global legitimacy. Its circulation alongside globally successful platform originals such as Stranger Things (Duffer Brothers, 2016) and Dark (Odar and Friese, 2017–2020) enhances visibility while subtly regulating form and content through platform norms. The paper concludes that Hindi OTT cinema and web series constitute an ambivalent cultural space in which India’s soft power is amplified and new representational possibilities particularly around gender, individuality, and digital life emerge, even as creative practices remain shaped by platform imperatives and global market logics.

papers.title: Translational Audiences in the Age of Transnational K-Pop
papers.titleZh: 跨国K-pop时代的翻译型受众
papers.takeaway: 海外粉丝不仅接收韩流，也通过字幕、反应视频、评论和再解读为内容生成新的意义。
papers.abstractZh: 海外粉丝不仅接收韩流，也通过字幕、反应视频、评论和再解读为内容生成新的意义。
papers.theory: 文化翻译超出语言转换，包含内容生产与意义生产两个交织过程。生产型翻译通过制作字幕、反应视频等重构文本；符号型翻译通过评论和讨论重新赋予价值。框架结合主动受众、编码解码和参与式文化，指出可获得字幕并不足以保证认同。
papers.data: 研究来自2015至2017年加拿大K-pop粉丝田野，访谈27名16至30岁青年：18名亚裔、8名白人、1名其他背景，除2人外均为女性。通过网络广告和滚雪球招募，排除从小已熟悉韩语和韩国文化的韩裔加拿大人。本篇从较大项目中聚焦文化解码经验。
papers.method: 定性访谈分析，以化名呈现粉丝如何接触韩流、使用翻译、分享内容及解释意义；用两种文化翻译过程组织材料，无对照组或总体随机抽样。
papers.results: 粉丝分享解释和反应可为陌生文化建立本地价值，同时数字平台的商业逻辑和过滤机制可能限制可见的解读。语言可达性与文化认同并非同一过程。
papers.relevance: 可把粉丝、字幕组和评论者作为文化中介研究，而不只测内容出口量和观看量。
papers.limitations: 加拿大早期青年粉丝样本，女性与亚裔占多；无法推断非粉丝受众或当下所有平台。期刊卷年2023，网页上线日期为2022年12月29日。
papers.originalAbstract: This article examines how overseas audiences of K-pop are not only the end users but also directly engage with the translation of the cultural flow. The audiences participate in linguistic translation and furthermore negotiate and re-decode the linguistically translated texts. Acknowledging that the reception of foreign cultural content is open to continued cross-cultural decoding by different stakeholders, including audience members as well as cultural intermediaries, this article focuses on transnational audiences’ engagement with two modes of cultural translation practices—producerly and semiotic translation. The article examines audiences’ experiences of cultural translation and the reconfiguration of audiencehood in the era of transnational digital media.

papers.title: Digital Mediascapes, Institutional Frameworks, and Audience Practices Across Europe
papers.titleZh: 欧洲数字媒体景观、制度与受众实践
papers.authors: Zrinjka Peruško; Dina Vozab; Antonija Čuvalo
papers.takeaway: 将宏观媒体系统与个人使用习惯联系起来，说明跨国文化差异需要同时考察制度和媒体供给结构。
papers.abstractZh: 将宏观媒体系统与个人使用习惯联系起来，说明跨国文化差异需要同时考察制度和媒体供给结构。
papers.theory: 数字媒体景观包括制度包容性、媒体市场、文化经济和全球化。媒体选择既可能由个人年龄、教育和收入解释，也受宏观可获得性与制度环境约束。因此跨国差异不能直接被命名为文化偏好。
papers.data: 第一阶段是22个欧洲国家加以色列，共23国的系统指标；摘要的简写与正文国家口径须区分。来源包括民主指数、人类发展数据、报业、宽带、智能手机、电视集中度、文化进出口和KOF全球化，指标年份不同。第二阶段九国在线调查10,742人：比利时、克罗地亚、丹麦、德国、匈牙利、以色列、意大利、波兰、葡萄牙。样本面向互联网用户；网络覆盖较低国家可能偏向年轻、富裕和高教育者。
papers.method: 指标标准化后用Ward层次聚类与欧氏距离划分系统，再用分层多元回归，先纳入性别、年龄、教育和收入，再加入系统类别；因变量区分纸报与网络新闻、电视机与电脑手机观看。
papers.results: 形成东欧等、西欧、斯堪的纳维亚及以色列四类；制度结构增加了对媒介使用的解释。该结果是观察性关联，不能推出改变制度必然导致同等使用变化。
papers.relevance: 研究文化接近或跨国内容接受时，应把市场和技术结构与个人因素分别控制，避免国家标签承担全部解释。
papers.limitations: 非实验，宏观样本仅23国且部分指标年份不一；调查不涵盖离线人口。斯堪的纳维亚受众调查仅丹麦代表，不能直接推广全部北欧。
papers.originalAbstract: This article explores the relationship between the media-use patterns of European audiences and the institutional contexts of digital media systems in a multilevel, cross-national comparative research design. A theoretical model is proposed for describing contemporary digital media systems, applied through cluster analysis to a set of 22 European countries. Four digital media system clusters are identified. Regression analysis shows the influence of macro-level media systems on micro-level audience preferences for different media. The media system clusters are related to data on media use from the nine countries in the “audiences across media” study. The findings strongly support the explanatory power of structural aspects at the macro-institutional level for audience choices in terms of both legacy and Internet-based media.

papers.title: Changing Patterns of Media Use across Cultures: A Challenge for Longitudinal Research
papers.titleZh: 跨文化媒体使用的变化：纵向研究的挑战
papers.authors: Uwe Hasebrink; Klaus Bruhn Jensen; Hilde van den Bulck; Sascha Hölig; Pieter Maeseele
papers.takeaway: 将欧洲九国2013年受众调查与三国纵向证据结合，讨论数字媒体扩散如何改变可比较的媒介使用模式。
papers.abstractZh: 将欧洲九国2013年受众调查与三国纵向证据结合，讨论数字媒体扩散如何改变可比较的媒介使用模式。
papers.theory: 理论把媒体使用看作技术、产业和文化共同塑造的实践；国家之间互联网普及不同步，横截面差异可能部分反映扩散阶段。这个视角要求分开国家差异、时间变化和测量变化。
papers.data: 摘要确认九国2013年调查，以及比利时、丹麦和德国的纵向材料。各国样本量、纵向资料起止年份、是否追踪同一人、招募与权重本次未核验。不能借用同专题其他论文的样本作为本篇统一样本。
papers.method: 跨国比较结合国家层面纵向证据；具体统计程序未核验。跨国扩散的阶段差异可用于理解时间变化，但不是随机赋予国家发展阶段的自然实验。
papers.results: 作者提出未来跨文化纵向媒体研究的测量与比较挑战；摘要未给统一效应系数。
papers.relevance: 日后检索不同主题时，可用作审查研究设计的依据：媒介名称一致是否意味着实践一致，跨国差异是否只是技术阶段不同。
papers.limitations: 只有摘要核验；为2015年方法研究，不能当作2026年当前平台使用的描述。
papers.originalAbstract: This article places the 2013 European audience survey in the wider historical context of the ongoing societal appropriation of digital media. To better understand longitudinal changes in the patterns of media use, the article compares the technological, industrial, and cultural factors that, together, shape the observable patterns of media use. Because Internet diffusion does not occur at exactly the same time in all countries, comparisons of audiences across the nine countries of the survey can be interpreted in terms of changes over time. The article, further, reports longitudinal evidence from Belgium, Denmark, and Germany, which sheds additional light on current changes at the country level. Building on these findings, the article finally addresses key challenges for future longitudinal research on media use across cultures.

papers.title: Tracking Configurable Culture From the Margins to the Mainstream
papers.titleZh: 可重组文化如何从边缘进入主流
papers.takeaway: 两轮调查显示混剪等数字文化活动更加普遍，但深度创作仍与资源分布有关。
papers.abstractZh: 两轮调查显示混剪等数字文化活动更加普遍，但深度创作仍与资源分布有关。
papers.theory: 作者用可重组文化解释文化材料在消费和再生产间流动，同时强调技能、资本和网络可能影响参与深度。
papers.data: 2006年美国样本1,779人；2010年3,055名英语成年受访者来自多国，使用在线面板。两轮样本范围与权重处理不同。
papers.method: 描述性重复调查，区分知晓、消费和创作参与，并非跟踪同一人的因果设计。
papers.results: 数字再创作从边缘走向常见，资源差异仍关联参与。
papers.relevance: 研究文化扩散时，可分开接触作品和实际参与生产。
papers.limitations: 在线英语样本限制代表性；历史结果不直接描述今日平台。
papers.abstractUnavailableReason: 原文摘要已核验；未确认完整转载许可，请通过来源链接阅读完整摘要。
